compendium.summary: Long-duration service requiring setup, cost and a valid target.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Downtime service loop. Only worth it if creature access and setup are real.
Pre-cast gate: Keep an eligible creature present through the casting and write commands that can actually be followed.
Failure state: Containment fails, the save succeeds, duration assumptions are wrong, or commands backfire.
Safe operating default: Use negotiated service when possible; confirm the exact summon/binding interaction.
tactics: Its completed effect does not require concentration, but the hour spent casting does. A single caster normally cannot maintain a concentration summon and cast Binding at the same time.
A second caster solves the competing-concentration problem, not every duration problem: the target must still exist and stay in range throughout the whole binding cast.
Wish can remove the long casting and costly-component requirements at Wizard 17. The target's eligibility, saving throw and hostile interpretation of commands still matter.
Nystul's Magic Aura does not make a prisoner willing or remove Legendary Resistance. The more permissive universal-binding loop remains disputed.
